description: Use when the user wants today's best-selling / top 30 products of a Naver Shopping category (네이버쇼핑 베스트) with price, discount, rating, reviews, store and delivery columns, or a price comparison of its top products. The data is the latest finished daily ranking (snapshot_date says which day). Costs 300 credits per category per day, whatever the limit; fetching the same day again is free; daily free credits are used first. A category name that matches several categories, or none, returns a list and charges nothing. The first paid use needs the user's agreement to the data terms (accept_terms).

accept_terms.description: The data terms version the user was shown and clearly agreed to (e.g. "v0.2"). Only set it after the user agrees; never agree for the user.

category.description: Category id (e.g. "50001081") or name / path part (e.g. "커피"). See naver_categories.

csv_path.description: Absolute path ending in .csv. Saves ALL rows to this file (UTF-8 with BOM, opens in Excel) instead of returning them in the answer.

limit.description: Rows 1-30 (default 30). The price is the same.

use_credits.description: Set true only if the user wants to spend their own credits after today's free credits are used up.

name: naver_top
title: Naver Shopping category top 30
